name: edu.tacc.apriltags
description: Multi-user AR colocation from wall-mounted AprilTags: devices anchor a shared room frame by fitting the positions of tags surveyed once into room_config.json. Platform-neutral core; iPhone (AR Foundation) and Meta Quest (MR Utility Kit) camera sources compile when those packages are present. Requires edu.umn.cs.ivlab.apriltag (see README).
